name: CoinGecko
description: The most widely used cross-chain cryptocurrency market data API. Provides token prices, OHLCV, market cap, volume, and metadata across thousands of tokens and chains. The default choice for cross-chain market data when Birdeye's Solana-native depth is not required.

ecosystem_fit.notes: Valid for cross-chain price feeds on Solana tokens. Use Birdeye when Solana-native depth (DEX liquidity, on-chain price discovery) is more important than cross-chain coverage.
Default market data source for Ethereum tokens. Broadest coverage.
Covers Base tokens including emerging ecosystem tokens.
Used in Farcaster miniapps that display token price context.

common_pairings.context: Birdeye for Solana-native on-chain price discovery with DEX depth. CoinGecko for cross-chain coverage and off-chain aggregated prices. Use Birdeye when Solana-native data quality matters; CoinGecko when cross-chain coverage matters.
AI agents use CoinGecko as a market data tool — the agent calls CoinGecko to fetch token prices as context for trading decisions.

trust_evidence.description: CoinGecko is the most referenced market data API across crypto applications. Used in production across virtually every crypto ecosystem.
Well-maintained public API with free tier and Pro tier for higher rate limits.

scale_guidance.hackathon: Use the free tier — adequate for demos. Rate limits are generous.
scale_guidance.mvp: Free tier sufficient. Upgrade to Pro when rate limits become a bottleneck.
scale_guidance.production: Use CoinGecko Pro API for higher rate limits and reliability SLAs.

alternatives.when_to_prefer: Solana-native workloads where on-chain price discovery from DEX pools is required. Birdeye aggregates Solana DEX data in real-time; CoinGecko is off-chain aggregated.

anti_patterns: Using CoinGecko free tier in high-frequency production workloads — rate limits will cause failures.
Using CoinGecko for Solana trading bots where on-chain price accuracy matters — Birdeye's DEX-native pricing is more accurate for Solana DeFi.
